salt-grain.name: klayout-power-pcells
salt-grain.title: Power MOSFET, common-centroid and generator PCells, with live DRC
salt-grain.doc: The sky130_power library: HW_FET, a hybrid-waffle power MOSFET (after Yoo et al., ISPSD 2008) for sky130A, drawn from raw layers: square source/drain regions in a checkerboard with one straight gate per shared edge, notches at the poly crossings with gate contacts and a met1 gate mesh, and 45 degree met3/met4(/met5) S/D runners into L-shaped buses. nfet/pfet 1.8 V (incl. lvt, hvt), 5 V, and 16 V extended-drain (LDMOS); diag45, staircase or planes runners. Checked with the PDK's KLayout deck, Magic DRC and netgen LVS. The centroid library: CC_ARRAY, common-centroid matched arrays (interdigitated, checkerboard, symmetric or optimized patterns, odd counts via centre cell and triads, dummy ring) of any klayout-magic-pcells unit cell, with a mismatch/gradient report and a DRC-clean automatic pitch on sky130A. The sky130_gen and gf180mcu_gen libraries: GUARD_RING and VIA_STACK. Live DRC (Tools > Live verify): the PDK deck on the visible or just-edited area, sky130A and gf180mcuD. Also contains klayout-magic-pcells 0.6.1 (sky130_magic and the other Magic libraries). Install this package instead of klayout-magic-pcells, not next to it.
